tools.name: search_equipment_models
tools.description: Search the OceanSphere equipment library (marine engines, auxiliaries, pumps, deck machinery, navigation and electrical equipment) by model designation, equipment type or keywords; optionally filter by manufacturer, ship_area or category. Returns at most 8 models (no paging) with manufacturer, designation, category, ship area, the number of source-referenced characteristics, a model_ref and the library page URL. Models without stored values are flagged 'no stored values'. Results with stored values come first. The library identifies equipment; it is not a parts shop - OceanSphere does not list stock. Use model_ref with get_equipment_model.

query.description: Model designation, equipment type or keywords, e.g. 'S50ME-C' or 'fuel injection pump'.
query.title: Query

manufacturer.description: Optional manufacturer filter, e.g. 'MAN Energy Solutions'.
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

ship_area.description: Ship area slug from list_ship_areas: engine_room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, hvac.
ship_area.title: Ship Area

category.description: Category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Radar & ECDIS'.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum number of results; values above 8 are capped at 8.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_equipment_model
tools.description: Get one library model (model_ref from a search, or manufacturer + exact designation): category, ship area, page URL, manufacturer datasheet link if any, and the stored technical characteristics. Each value has source_document (label of the catalogue/datasheet it was extracted from; may cover a model series) and source_page. Values were extracted automatically and are not individually reviewed. If there are no stored values the response says so explicitly; never guess specifications in that case. OceanSphere does not hold stock.

model_ref.description: model_ref returned by search_equipment_models or find_by_manufacturer.
model_ref.title: Model Ref

manufacturer.description: Alternative to model_ref: manufacturer (together with designation).
manufacturer.title: Manufacturer

designation.description: Alternative to model_ref: exact model designation (together with manufacturer).
designation.title: Designation

tools.name: find_by_manufacturer
tools.description: List models of one manufacturer, best-documented first, at most 8 per call and no paging (total_matches shows the size). Narrow with category or ship_area, or use search_equipment_models with a designation to reach a specific model.

category.description: Category name from list_categories, e.g. 'Radar & ECDIS'.
category.title: Category

ship_area.description: Ship area slug from list_ship_areas: engine_room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, hvac.
ship_area.title: Ship Area

limit.description: Maximum number of results; values above 8 are capped at 8.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_ship_areas
tools.description: List the ship areas of the library (engine room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, HVAC) with model counts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the equipment categories with model counts, optionally for one ship_area. Use the names as category filter.

ship_area.description: Ship area slug from list_ship_areas: engine_room, deck, electrical, navigation, safety, cargo, hvac.
ship_area.title: Ship Area
